title: SnowAuth
description: SnowAuth, is a lightweight and high-performance Minecraft authentication solution designed for Spigot/Paper servers (1.21+)
body:
_SnowAuth, is a lightweight and high-performance Minecraft authentication solution designed for Spigot/Paper servers (1.20+). Here's a summary of its features:_

*Key Features:*
- 🔒 *Authentication System*: Supports `/register`, `/login`, and `/changepassword` commands
- ❌ *Player Freeze*: Prevents movement, chat, and commands before login
- ⏰ *Auto-Kick*: Configurable timeout for kicking players who don't log in
- 📦 *Offline-Mode Support*: Compatible with cracked servers
- 💾 *Local Data Storage*: Stores player data in YAML or JSON files (no SQL required)
- 🔄 *Session System*: Auto-login for players within a configurable time frame
- 📝 *Customizable Messages*: Configurable titles and actionbar messages for login/register prompts
- 🔧 *Admin Tools*: `/resetpassword` command for admins to manage player accounts

*Config Options:*
- ⏱️ Login timeout
- 🕒 Session duration
- 📝 Customizable messages


```

```
SnowAuth provides a secure and simple way to authenticate players, making it an ideal solution for Minecraft servers.
